source: https://prearrival.immigration.gov.vn/ (the portal's English message file assets/v1.0.0/en-DCeEXg7L.js and date code in App--Uwavn_J.js, read 2026-11-18 in a browser). The form sits behind a CAPTCHA and was not opened or submitted, so only checks stated in the portal's own messages are kept.

arrival_date.label: Expected arrival date
arrival_date.help: DD/MM/YYYY. The portal says: 'The expected arrival date must be today or within the next 2 days.' Open it once your arrival is at most two calendar days away.

errors.tooEarly: The expected arrival date must be today or within the next 2 days
errors.tooLate: Too early to submit: the expected arrival date must be today or within the next 2 days
errors.invalidDay: That day does not exist in this month

date_of_birth.label: Date of birth
date_of_birth.help: As on the passport. The portal rejects a date in the future.

errors.tooLate: Date of birth cannot be in the future.
errors.invalidDay: That day does not exist in this month

passport_expiry.label: Passport expiry date
passport_expiry.help: The portal rejects an expired passport. It also checks that a visa ends at least 30 days before the passport does. This field cannot be changed later; a wrong value means a new declaration.

errors.tooEarly: Passport expiry date cannot be in the past.
errors.invalidDay: That day does not exist in this month

phone.label: Phone number (without country code)
phone.help: Digits only, 3 to 14. The country code is a separate box.

errors.invalidFormat: The phone number must contain only digits and be between 3 and 14 characters long.

email.label: Email address
email.help: A 6-digit code is sent here before you submit, and the lookup and update service sends its OTP here too. Use an inbox you control.
